answer_1.quote: We construct and analyze personalized dialogues generated across a spectrum of polarized profiles... We adopt the ConvAI2 dataset and define user personas primarily through descriptive sentences.

answer_2.quote: We adopt four consistency metrics (C score, Contradiction Ratio, Perplexity gap, GPT Score) and four coherence metrics (Perplexity, Q‑DCE, PairEval, G‑Eval) to assess the dialogues.

answer_3.quote: Inspired by CoT evaluation framework for summarization tasks, we adapt a similar approach with GPT‑4o to evaluate dialogue quality... PairEval utilizes a fine‑tuned LLaMA‑2 model to compare generated dialogues with reference responses.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation on a subset of samples. Three fluent English speakers then rate these samples using the same criteria as the LLM‑based automatic evaluation, but on a condensed 1‑3 scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each dialogue on a 1‑3 scale according to the same criteria used for automatic evaluation (consistency and coherence).
